overview: The Shadow Front is the outer edge of Shadow Valley, where shadow energies first breach Luclin’s surface.
history: Shadow fractures appeared along the valley rim as Akhevan rituals intensified.
Local wildlife began to show signs of corruption and void‑scar mutations.
Akhevan scout detachments established forward observation posts along the front.
Vah Shir and Combine scouts reported increasing instability in the terrain and sky.
During the Terror of Luclin, the Shadow Front became the primary entry point into Shadow Valley.
hooks: A newly formed shadow fracture threatens to expand into nearby terrain.
An Akhevan scout party is seen marking locations along the front.
A corrupted beast emerges from a fresh void‑scar.
A scout outpost requests assistance stabilizing a shadow anomaly.
